waiting.title: Enter your Steam account name
waiting.detail: Use the account login name in the Steam window. This can be different from your public profile name or email address.

installing-rosetta.title: Approve Apple’s Rosetta setup
installing-rosetta.detail: Valve’s downloader needs Apple’s free Rosetta. Review its agreement in the Steam window. The game itself will still run natively.

updating-steam.title: Steam is getting ready
updating-steam.detail: Valve’s downloader is updating itself. Keep its window open; sign-in will follow automatically.

waiting-password.title: Enter your Steam password
waiting-password.detail: Type it in the Steam window. Password characters may stay invisible while you type; that is normal. Press Return once.

awaiting-guard.title: Complete Steam Guard
awaiting-guard.detail: Approve the sign-in in your Steam mobile app, or enter the newest email/authenticator code in the Steam window. Never enter the code here.

wrong-password.title: Steam rejected the password
wrong-password.detail: Check the account login name and password. If Steam is still asking, retry in its window; otherwise start sign-in again. Use Steam’s account help if needed.

wrong-account.title: Steam could not find that account
wrong-account.detail: Use your Steam account login name, not your display name. Steam’s account help can recover it.

wrong-code.title: Steam Guard needs a new code
wrong-code.detail: Use the newest code or approval request. Old email/authenticator codes can expire. Retry in the Steam window if it is still open.

expired-code.title: Steam Guard needs a new code
expired-code.detail: Use the newest code or approval request. Old email/authenticator codes can expire. Retry in the Steam window if it is still open.

rate-limited.title: Steam needs a short break
rate-limited.detail: Too many sign-in attempts were made. Wait a few minutes before trying again; repeated retries can extend the limit.

no-license.title: This Steam account does not own the game
no-license.detail: Sign in with the account that owns Generals or Zero Hour. Ultimate Collection includes them; Remastered Collection does not. Family-shared access may not work with SteamCMD.

network-error.title: Steam could not connect
network-error.detail: Check your connection and Steam’s service status, then try again. Already downloaded files are kept.

downloading.title: Steam is downloading and checking your game
downloading.detail: Keep the Steam window open. This can take several minutes. We will unlock Play only after its files validate.

incomplete.title: The Steam step did not finish
incomplete.detail: Reopen sign-in to resume and validate the download. If you saw “No subscription”, check ownership and the Steam account first.

idle.title: Ready for Steam sign-in
idle.detail: Only Valve’s Steam window handles your password and Steam Guard. The launcher will guide you as it progresses.
